message.content: {"draft":"Use 2D grid (rows, chunks) with atomic_add to split wide rows across CTAs. Small widths use single CTA. Reduces latency for worst shape [256,4096] while preserving correctness for odd sizes.","plan":"1) Host: pick BLOCK=1024, compute n_chunks=ceil(width/BLOCK). 2) If n_chunks==1, launch 1D grid. 3) Else launch 2D grid; each CTA loads its slice, sums in FP32, atomic_adds to out. 4) After kernel, multiply out by 1/width. 5) Return out.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _mean_single(","    X,","    Y,","    stride_x,","    width,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","):","    row = tl.program_id(0)","    X += row * stride_x","    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = cols < width","    x = tl.load(X + cols, mask=mask, other=0.).to(tl.float32)","    s = tl.sum(x, axis=0)","    mean = s / width","    y = mean.to(Y.dtype.element_ty)","    tl.store(Y + row, y)","","","@triton.jit","def _mean_multi(","    X,","    Y,","    stride_x,","    width,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","):","    row = tl.program_id(0)","    chunk = tl.program_id(1)","    X += row * stride_x + chunk * BLOCK_SIZE","    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = cols < width - chunk * BLOCK_SIZE","    x = tl.load(X + cols, mask=mask, other=0.).to(tl.float32)","    s = tl.sum(x, axis=0)","    tl.atomic_add(Y + row, s)","","","def run(x):","    assert x.is_cuda","    assert x.dim() == 2","    assert x.is_contiguous()","    rows, width = x.shape","    out = torch.zeros((rows,), dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)","    BLOCK = 1024","    n_chunks = triton.cdiv(width, BLOCK)","    if n_chunks == 1:","        BLOCK_SIZE = triton.next_power_of_2(width)","        grid = (rows,)","        _mean_single[grid](x, out, x.stride(0), width, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE)","        out = out.to(x.dtype)","    else:","        grid = (rows, n_chunks)","        _mean_multi[grid](x, out, x.stride(0), width, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK)","        out = (out / width).to(x.dtype)","    return out"]}
